body:
It was Feb. 13 2009, and I was staying at a friends house and he had just got 9 30mg Adderall capsules. So at midnight we began to crush the beads inside the capsules and by 12:30am we had snorted 90mg each. We sat in his room listening to what we called 'really deep' music for the next 7hours and as we started to crash we both snorted another 45mg each. We left his house and went to a park for the next few hours and met up with a few people and smoked a few bowls of upper-mids. This turned out to be a really bad idea because we got the munchies, however, the Adderall made any food we tried to eat taste and feel like dirt. But that was the only bad part about the day. I went home and slept for the next 13hours.
